in_marathi.name: Navodit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे New, Innovative, Delightful
in_marathi.long_meaning: Navodit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Navodit is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Navodita', which means 'New' or 'Innovative'. This name is often given to a baby as a symbol of delight and hope for a new beginning.
